scenarios.name: draw-step-skipped
scenarios.why: The static effect skips its controller's draw step. The setup enchantment is present before the game begins, and the first player's turn-two draw therefore does not add a card.

scenarios.name: card-going-to-graveyard-exiled-instead
scenarios.why: A card that would be put into its controller's graveyard from the stack is exiled instead, so the resolved Lightning Bolt is not in the graveyard.

scenarios.name: without-enchantment-draw-step-draws
scenarios.why: Without the skip effect, the first player's turn-two draw step draws one card normally.
